open_issues.summary: Restart is incorrectly bound to reload-reserved R instead of F6

blocking_focus: Remap bootstrap restart/reset from physical R to F6; R is reserved exclusively for FPS reload.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Restore deterministic bootstrap restart through physical F6 while reserving physical R for FPS reload, preserving the verified room, movement, camera, mouse-capture, and reset behavior.

diagnosis.root_cause: The `restart` InputMap action in `project.godot` is bound to physical R instead of F6. The existing action handler and `_reset_to_spawn()` implementation already restore the preserved spawn transform, camera orientation, zero velocity, and captured mouse correctly, so this is an isolated configuration defect rather than a player-script or transform defect.

stop_conditions: Stop after the restart action is bound exclusively to physical F6 and no restart event remains on physical R.
Do not alter `_reset_to_spawn()`, movement, mouse-look, camera framing, spawn values, room geometry, lighting, or collision unless focused validation proves an unexpected regression.
Do not expand this bootstrap repair into weapons, HUD, minimap, enemies, objectives, authored maps, decorative assets, or backlog phase work.
Do not claim issue or phase closure until GameLoop Runtime and Tester complete the required runtime recapture and formal verdict.

strategy.rationale: Repair the defect at its direct ownership boundary: replace only the erroneous `restart` InputMap event in `project.godot`. Preserve the already-correct player reset path and avoid unnecessary script or transform tuning.

code: Inspect the final `[input]` configuration and confirm `restart` contains physical F6, contains no physical R event, and has no duplicate or unrelated binding.
Confirm the focused change does not modify `scripts/prototype_player.gd` or any room, scene, camera, collision, lighting, or asset files.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime must launch the candidate and retain a passing `clean_boot` result with no missing-resource or script errors.

Tester must move and rotate the live player away from spawn twice, press physical F6 on each attempt, and verify position `(0, 0.9, 5.4)`, zero velocity, zero yaw and pitch, and captured input after each reset.
Tester must displace the player again, press physical R, and verify that position, orientation, and reset state do not jump back to spawn.
visual: In the matched post-F6 gameplay view, Tester must confirm the preserved bounded room remains visible and the camera returns upright to its original spawn framing without black frames or visible scene regression.

done_when: The `restart` action has exactly the intended physical F6 keyboard event and contains no physical R event.
Physical R is not mapped to restart and remains available for the later reload action.
The existing `_reset_to_spawn()` call path and its restoration semantics are unchanged.
The bounded bootstrap room, player hierarchy, spawn at `(0, 0.9, 5.4)`, 75-degree camera framing, 82-degree pitch clamp, movement, mouse capture/release, and clean boot remain intact.
tasks.instructions: Edit only the candidate-owned InputMap configuration in `project.godot`: change the `restart` action from physical R to physical F6, retaining a physical-key binding suitable for ordinary keyboard input. Do not add an R alias or modify `scripts/prototype_player.gd`; its action dispatch and `_reset_to_spawn()` behavior are already correct. Keep all preserved bootstrap content and behavior unchanged.
